title: A Bug’s Life Hopper Trading Card McDonald’s 1998 Disney Pixar
descriptionText:
This A Bug's Life Hopper Trading Card from McDonald's is a must-have for any Disney or Pixar fan. Released in 1998, it features the beloved character Hopper and is a great addition to any non-sport trading card collection. The card is in excellent shape and is sure to impress any collector.

The card is from the A Bug's Life movie and TV show franchise, making it a unique and sought-after item. It is perfect for those who love to collect memorabilia from their favorite movies and TV shows. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own this rare and valuable trading card.
